SELECT t.id AS teachingId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_code AS courseCode, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(u2.realname ORDER BY u2.realname SEPARATOR '、') FROM sys_user u2 WHERE FIND_IN_SET(u2.id, t.teacher_id) ) AS teacherName, d.depart_name AS departName, t.semester AS semester, t.academic_year AS academicYear FROM ainote_teaching t INNER JOIN ainote_course c ON t.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_depart d ON t.depart_id = d.id WHERE t.status = 1 AND t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ainote_course_selection cs WHERE cs.teaching_id = t.id AND cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND cs.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND cs.status = 1 )
AND c.course_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{courseName}, '%')

SELECT cs.id, cs.student_id AS studentId, su.realname AS studentName, cs.teaching_id AS teachingId, cs.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_code AS courseCode, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(u2.realname ORDER BY u2.realname SEPARATOR '、') FROM sys_user u2 WHERE FIND_IN_SET(u2.id, t.teacher_id) ) AS teacherName, cs.depart_id AS departId, d.depart_name AS departName, cs.semester, cs.academic_year AS academicYear, cs.status, cs.selected_at AS selectedAt FROM ainote_course_selection cs LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON cs.student_id = su.id LEFT JOIN ainote_teaching t ON cs.teaching_id = t.id LEFT JOIN ainote_course c ON cs.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_depart d ON cs.depart_id = d.id WHERE cs.teaching_id = #{teachingId} AND cs.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND cs.status = 1 ORDER BY su.realname ASC
